summary: Five misses whose results arrived after the review of their week, found once the export stopped using a date window. Three are election calls made before the Nov 8 checklist item on national swing existed (a state or incumbent record weighed over this year's environment); two were near coin flips. That pattern is already covered, so no checklist items are proposed.

misses.note: A near coin flip at 55%: through Oct 22 two of three trackers showed a Ukrainian net gain for the month and one showed about zero; the resolving tracker's month ended the other way.
58% for a touch 4% above spot with 19 days left was no higher than the volatility estimate; the level was not reached.
89% rested on two past wins of about 10 points; this year's national swing and a poll showing a 3-point race were named but hardly weighed, and no poll was listed with its numbers.

Anchored on the 93% incumbent rate, which does not fit a same-party contest in a redrawn district; two sponsor polls at +10 and +13 and the Republican runner-up's endorsement pointed to the challenger even after a discount.

80% on an expected margin of a few points among white voters, with one of three late polls showing Democrats ahead in that group and a tie resolving against; a margin that thin supports about 60 to 65%.
